Which tight growth bound describes this recurrence? Use a bounded positive base case and consider sufficiently large input size n.

```formula essential
T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n / log_2(n)
where
T(n): the running time on input size n
n: the input size, larger than the fixed base-case threshold
log_2(n): the base-2 logarithm of n
In words: two half-size calls are followed by slightly less than linear outside work.
```

options.explanation: The outside contributions still accumulate over the levels; the slowly growing log-log factor cannot be dropped.
This would apply to linear outside work. Dividing that work by a logarithm reduces the accumulated factor.
Correct. The balancing exponent is one, and the outside-work integral grows like the logarithm of a logarithm.
The recurrence has half-size calls and sublinear outside work; there is no quadratic root or leaf contribution.
